answer.reason: The validation contract applies to one session.json object at a time. Candidate discovery, branch paths, aggregate reporting, correction routing and freeze output naming are supplied by ID3 tooling.
answer.original_rule_migration_recommended: Preserve original v1.1 rule publication unchanged; it is exactly the rule already bundled in the migrated original ID3 release.
answer.four_case_limit: The original rule has baseline/variant scoring.report metadata, but no two-candidate cardinality validator. Current original ID3 scripts explicitly operate on two branches; preserving a shared field rule does not make those scripts process four cases.
answer.local_rule_versioning_note: Local four-case JSON changes labels, report metadata and session-ID correction guidance while retaining original identifiers. Do not represent it as byte-identical original v1.1. A future published profile/revision should record those changes and apply the publication version/changelog discipline.
answer.runtime_claim_limit: Static field-contract equality is not a tested replacement of the original rule into four-case scripts and does not establish four-case freeze eligibility.

unchanged_migration_checks: Source ZIP sidecar and CRC; extracted member bytes; nine internal checksums; original PDF/JSON/Markdown preservation.
JSON parsing, unique field paths and all validator references; literal source manifest includes present.
Exact rule equality to already migrated ID3 and prior passed positive-workflow evidence.
After copy: destination file set/hashes including original checksums, unchanged pre-existing collection files, new collection manifest and local reference links.
future_four_case_work: Review four-branch discovery/reporting/correction/freeze code and versioned documentation separately from candidate count.
Retain and resolve supplied required-field failures through author decisions; the prior four-case records retain empty session_status.intended_reuse.
If runtime or validation logic changes, use bounded positive and required-field-negative fixtures with human gate and hash verification; no source freeze is authorised by this review.
